title: 第26章 比赛第27章 大会第一天
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 随着裁判宣布个人赛开始，整个会场的气氛瞬间沸腾起来。
各派弟子摩拳擦掌，准备在擂台上大展身手。
观世宗休息区，赵归涯正懒洋洋地靠在椅子上，手里把玩着那枚‘万法令’。
风翼蹲在他肩膀上，小爪子不停地往嘴里塞灵果。
楚安芷走过来，在他身边坐下：“小未，你你刚刚进休息区拿的号牌是几号？”
赵归涯嗑着瓜子：“三号。”
楚安芷闻言挑了挑眉：“三号啊，我刚刚晃了一圈我们丙组第三场地是和沁河谷的人打，虽然他们也是小型宗门，但他们都是音修，有把握吗？”
赵归涯闻言，手中的瓜子突然停在半空：“音修啊，我还好，就是不知道他们三个能不能对付。”
他又想了想，“嗯…”
，从‘缠契’戒中取出一把造型古朴的琵琶，“要不等会儿我用这个打？”
“算了算了，这琵琶可是我收集了好多上等材料才做出来的。”
然后又把琵琶塞了回去。
楚安芷：……
这是欧阳旭白，柳家兄妹也从外面走了进来。
“小未来我怎么刚刚好像看到你把‘迷魂’拿出来了，怎么你想抡起你的琵琶往对手脑壳上砸呀。”
楚安是诡异扭头盯着赵归涯。
你刚刚心疼你的琵琶，是因为想直接上手抡起琵琶抱对方头吗？
赵归涯被楚安芷盯得有些心虚，讪讪地摸了摸鼻子：“师尊别这么看我……我这不是想对方是音修，基本都是精神攻击我也要拿出匹配的武器嘛。”
欧阳叙白在一旁拆台：“未来，我记得你以前学乐器的时候弹了一半，觉得精神攻击不够，直接抡起琵琶往人家脑壳上打，当时乐门的一个弟子，哭着说你不懂怜香惜玉。”
“闭嘴！”
赵归涯一把捂住欧阳叙白的嘴，转头对楚安芷干笑两声，“师尊别听他瞎说，我其实琵琶弹的挺好的。”
楚安芷扶额：“所以你真的打算用琵琶砸人？”
就在众人说话间，叶知秋和封无痕，带着一位长清冷的白衣仙君走了进来。
“比赛还有半个时辰就要开始了你们在聊什么呢？”
封无痕问。
楚安芷在赵归涯恳切的眼神中说出“在讨论等会儿的比赛。”
她对上那位白衣仙君那温柔的眼神是一愣：“二位师兄，这位道友是？”
叶知秋正要介绍就被白衣仙君抢先。
白衣仙君向楚安芷行了一礼：“在下玄冥宗弟子，白望舒。”
随后有些伤心的看向楚安芷：“仙子，你不记得我了吗？”
楚安芷一脸懵逼。
感觉名字有点耳熟。
突然一道声音从脑海里响起。
师尊，他是你的追求者，前世在你死后，追杀了我好几百年。
嗯……他好像是你前几年下山历练的时候救下的人。
楚安芷听到赵归涯的传音，差点被自己的口水呛到。
她用余光看了一眼赵归涯，赵归涯朝她微笑。
她努力维持着面上的平静，对白望舒露出一个礼貌的微笑：“原来是白道友，许久不见。”
白望舒眼中闪过一丝失落，但很快又恢复温柔的笑意：“仙子忘了也是正常。
content_en:
As the referee announced the start of the individual competition, the atmosphere in the entire venue boiled instantly.
Disciples from all factions are gearing up to show off their skills in the ring.
In the Guanshizong rest area, Zhao Guiya was lazily leaning on his chair, playing with the 'Ten Thousand Laws' in his hand.
Fengyi squatted on his shoulder and kept stuffing ling berries into his mouth with his little paws.
Chu Anzhi came over and sat down next to him: "Xiaowei, what's the number plate you just got when you entered the rest area?"
Zhao Guiya chewed melon seeds: "No. 3."
Chu Anzhi raised her eyebrows when she heard this: "No. 3, I just walked around and our third venue in Group C is against the people from the Qin River Valley. Although they are also small sects, they are all music cultivators. Are you sure?"
When Zhao Guiya heard this, the melon seeds in his hand suddenly stopped in mid-air: "Yinxiu, I'm okay, I just don't know if the three of them can deal with it."
He thought about it again, "Well..."
, took out a simple-looking pipa from the 'Tang Contract' ring, "How about I play with this later?"
"Forget it, I made this Pipa after collecting a lot of high-quality materials."
Then he stuffed the pipa back.
Chu Anzhi:......
This is Ouyang Xubai, and the Liu family brothers and sisters also walked in from outside.
"Little Future, I just saw you taking out the 'Ecstasy'. Why do you want to pick up your pipa and hit your opponent on the head?"
Chu An turned his head and stared at Zhao Guiya strangely.
Did you feel sorry for your Pipa just now because you wanted to pick up the Pipa and hug the opponent's head?
Zhao Guiya felt a little guilty as he was stared at by Chu Anzhi, and he touched his nose awkwardly: "Master, don't look at me like that... I don't think the other party is a music cultivator. It's basically a mental attack. I have to come up with matching weapons."
Ouyang Xubai stood aside and said: "Future, I remember that when you were learning an instrument, you played half of it and felt that the mental attack was not enough, so you just picked up the pipa and hit people on the head. At that time, one of the disciples of Lemen cried and said that you don't know how to cherish the fragrance and cherish the jade."
"Shut up!"
Zhao Guiya covered Ouyang Xubai's mouth, turned around and laughed dryly at Chu Anzhi, "Master, don't listen to his nonsense, I actually play the pipa quite well."
Chu Anzhi raised her forehead: "So you really plan to hit someone with your pipa?"
While everyone was talking, Ye Zhiqiu and Feng Wuhen walked in with a cold-looking Immortal Lord in white clothes.
"The game starts in half an hour. What are you talking about?"
Feng Wuhen asked.
Chu Anzhi looked into Zhao Guiya's sincere eyes and said, "We are discussing the game later."
She was stunned when she met the gentle eyes of the white-clothed Immortal Lord: "Two senior brothers, who is this fellow Taoist?"
Ye Zhiqiu was about to make an introduction when he was preempted by the Immortal Lord in White.
The Immortal Lord in white bowed to Chu Anzhi: "I am a disciple of the Xuanming Sect, Bai Wangshu."
Then he looked at Chu Anzhi sadly: "Fairy, don't you remember me?"
Chu Anzhi was confused.
The name sounds familiar.
Suddenly a voice sounded in my head.
Master, he is your pursuer. In his previous life, he hunted me for hundreds of years after your death.
Hmm... He seems to be the person you saved when you went down the mountain for training a few years ago.
Chu Anzhi almost choked on her own saliva when she heard Zhao Guiya's message.
She glanced at Zhao Guiya with her peripheral vision, and Zhao Guiya smiled at her.
She tried hard to keep her face calm and gave Bai Wangshu a polite smile: "It turns out to be fellow Taoist Bai, long time no see."
A trace of disappointment flashed in Bai Wangshu's eyes, but he quickly returned to his gentle smile: "It's normal for fairies to forget.
